integrity_notes: Direct analytic proof of domain characterization, distribution, expectation, extremal ordering, and three scaling limits; standalone exhaustive checker included.
scientific_limitations: Complete bipartite candidate graphs and uniformly random rankings only; unrelated to Condorcet status of cyclic graph preference domains. Finite checks do not certify limits; priority may be affected by unindexed literature.
title: A three-regime nearest-swap law for complete-bipartite single-peaked domains
